project_type: React 18.3 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS + Vite frontend for MARBOU Sudan marketplace
build_system: Vite 5.4 with React plugin; npm scripts for dev/build/lint/typecheck
test_framework: None currently configured; project uses manual verification
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'npm run typecheck' to verify TypeScript passes. 2. Run 'npm run build' to create production bundle. 3. Manually verify imports and component usage in dev server via 'npm run dev'. 4. Test RTL mode by setting lang to 'ar' in browser. 5. Verify accessibility: test keyboard navigation, screen reader compatibility, 4.5:1 contrast ratios.
environment_constraints: Frontend runs on Vite dev server (:5173 default). No external API yet—uses mockData.ts. Supabase client is installed but not configured. lucide-react used for icons. RTL/LTR switching via I18nContext. ARIA labels and logical CSS properties required for accessibility.
contribution_requirements: Components must: (1) Use design tokens from tailwind.config.js (no hardcoded colors). (2) Follow React 18 best practices (memoization, lazy loading). (3) Support RTL via logical CSS (ps-, pe-, start, end). (4) Include ARIA labels and keyboard support. (5) Use TypeScript strict mode (zero 'any'). (6) Pass npm run typecheck without errors.
key_patterns: Existing code patterns found: (1) Components use useI18n() hook for translations. (2) Components use useRouter() for navigation. (3) Components use useApp() for global state (toast, dataSaver, etc.). (4) All UI components in src/components/ui.tsx (Toast, Modal, Badge, EmptyState, Skeleton, Breadcrumbs, StatusBadge, RatingStars, TrustBadge). (5) Form inputs use .input class from index.css (rounded-xl, border-sand-200, focus ring). (6) Pages import components and use them directly. (7) mockData.ts provides mock listings, businesses, jobs, categories, cities. (8) Format: categories have id, key (translation), icon, subcategories. (9) Listings have id, title, titleAr, price, city, cityAr, condition, status, postedAt, promoted, views, etc.
